All Features Included

Everything below ships out of the box — nothing is locked behind a paywall

Security

7 capabilities
  • AES-256-GCM local encryption · PBKDF2 with 600,000 iterations 本地加密 · PBKDF2 600,000 次迭代
  • Flexible session control — idle auto-lock, restart lock, one-click lock
  • Persistent session countdown with click-to-renew badge
  • Offline security audit — 0-100 score across 5 dimensions (weak / reused / leaked / expired / no 2FA)
  • Built-in TOTP 2FA (RFC 6238) with live codes and QR import（RFC 6238），实时活码 + 二维码导入
  • Password generator — random + EFF Diceware passphrase with live strength meter
  • Clipboard auto-clear — copied passwords expire on a configurable timer

Smart Autofill

5 capabilities
  • One-click login Ctrl+Shift+F — autofill + tick consent + click login — 自动填充 + 勾选协议 + 点击登录
  • Triple fill strategy — inline icon / side panel / global shortcut
  • Exact domain matching keeps dev / test / staging / prod accounts separate
  • Chrome-style auto-save with smart dedup and domain allow/blocklist
  • Broad compatibility — dynamic form detection (incl. cross-iframe), password visibility toggle

Data Management

5 capabilities
  • Import / export — CSV & JSON (Chrome / LastPass / Bitwarden / 1Password)
  • Encrypted backup (.aph) + email backup + scheduled reminders
  • 30-day trash + password change history (restorable encrypted snapshots)
  • Tags & filtering, favorites, one-click dedup, batch delete / retag, export selected entries
  • Atomic re-key on master password change — no data loss

Experience

4 capabilities
  • 6 color themes + bilingual UI (中文 / English), applied everywhere instantly + 中英双语界面，即时切换全局同步生效
  • Smart search — pinyin / initials matching with highlight
  • Site favicons from local browser cache — zero external requests
  • Instant side panel — ~20-50ms cached fast path 加载完成

Platform & Engineering

4 capabilities
  • Runs on Chrome / Edge / Brave / Arc / Firefox — whole Chromium family，Chromium 全家族通用
  • Works offline — no network calls except update checks
  • Update checks every 6h with in-popup notification
  • Open and auditable (GPL-3.0) — every crypto line reviewable），每一行加密代码都可复查
